visualization.description: Volcano plot of differential analysis results from http://plotly.com

input.label: Fold change threshold

input.help: Provide a label for the axis.

visualization.help:
# What is the Volcano Plot?
This visualization plots the results of a differential analysis, such as DESeq2, edgeR or limma output, as an interactive volcano plot using the [Plotly](https://plotly.com/) library: the fold change of each feature against the -log10 of its p-value.
Add a track and pick the columns for feature names, log2 fold changes and p-values (or adjusted p-values). For tables with several contrasts, add one track per contrast; each contrast gets its own panel.
## Key Features
- **Thresholds**: Features beyond the fold change and p-value thresholds are colored as up or down; the thresholds are drawn as dotted lines. - **Labels**: The most significant features are labeled, and every point shows its name, fold change and p-value on hover. Features with a p-value of 0 are drawn at the top of their panel. - **Several contrasts**: Compare contrasts side by side, one panel each. - **Large tables**: Rendered with WebGL for tens of thousands of features. - **Interactive**: Zoom, pan and export the plot as an image.
